headline: State Bank of Vietnam Officially Approves ABBank’s Plan to Increase Capital to Nearly VND 27,000 Billion
summary: The State Bank of Vietnam approved ABBank's proposal to raise charter capital by up to more than VND 10,765 billion. Charter capital is expected to reach over VND 26,833 billion after the issuance.
why: Capital raises strengthen a bank's lending capacity and balance sheet, and they can dilute existing shareholders. ABBank is a Vietnamese commercial bank listed on the UPCoM market.
